## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `.env.test` not read — a secret-read hook blocks reading the file. Its existence and git tracking were checked; every command got `DATABASE_URL` for the ephemeral DB instead.
- Ajv `$dynamicRef` false positives — Ajv 8.20.0 reported 182 errors validating `/openapi.json` against the OAS 3.1 meta-schema, all caused by Ajv resolving `$dynamicRef: "#meta"` to the document root. jsonschema-rs 0.30.0 reported 0 errors and passed three mutation negative controls. The jsonschema-rs verdict was recorded.
- Shared-target-dir artifact in BLD-DRIFT-02 — the first drift02 run reused drift01's test binary through a shared `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` and was discarded. drift02 was re-run with an isolated target dir.
- Screenshots — `docs/F10-openapi-documentation-and-swagger-ui/eval-screenshots-2026-11-23T22-22-36Z/` (UI-DOCS-01, UI-DOCS-02, UI-TRY-01, UI-TRY-02).
